mapper.insert: insert into aftersales_evidence (aftersales_id, file_path, original_name, uploaded_by, created_at) values (#{aftersalesId}, #{filePath}, #{originalName}, #{uploadedBy}, now())
mapper.select: select id, aftersales_id, file_path, original_name, uploaded_by, created_at from aftersales_evidence where aftersales_id = #{aftersalesId} order by id
select count(*) from aftersales_evidence where aftersales_id = #{aftersalesId}
